name: gpu_vision_infer
title: Object detection on the GPU
short_description: Object detection model on bundled camera images, on the graphics processor.

structured_text.description: Runs an object detection network on a bundled set of camera images on the graphics processor in half precision, the accelerated path of robots, vehicles and video analytics systems. The model, image size and batch size are fixed, and frames are uploaded and results read back as in a live pipeline.
structured_text.metric_explanation: The score is the number of images processed per second, including transfers to and from the GPU.
structured_text.value_interpretation: Higher is better. More images per second means more camera streams or higher frame rates for the same hardware.
structured_text.reasoning: Detection networks combine dense tensor math with memory traffic and data transfers, so this shows how well a GPU serves real perception workloads rather than peak matrix throughput alone.
